name: Detective Investigation Files
description:
"Detective Investigation Files" revolves around the professional and meticulous investigations carried out by a group of dedicated police officers. As they delve into mysterious deaths with unclear causes, they tirelessly work towards maintaining peace and security for the people. However, their demanding job often comes at the expense of personal happiness.

Cheung Dai Yong, a brilliant and astute police officer, has a track record of solving crucial cases. His trusted colleague, Lee Chung Yee, stands by his side, and together they tackle challenging and complex cases. Amidst their work, Dai Yong encounters Ko Jit, a tenacious journalist. Despite their initial conflicts, a deepening connection blossoms between them. However, Ko Jit already has a romantic partner.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: There is a terrible murder case in this strange society. The victim was chopped into pieces.The victim was chopped into pieces without the head and the abdomen. It is difficult to recognize its identity. Sergeant CHEUNG TAI YUNG and cop LEE CHUNG YEE are responsible for this difficult case. The coroner KONG YU HIM draws a conclusion according to the finger characteristics and believes that the victim is a thirty—years old nurse, LEE MAN FONG, wife of businessman CHOW CHUN KIT. The police starts a thorough investigation. They suspect three persons : Mr. CHOW, FONG’s lover Dr. CHOW and Mr. CHOW's mistress, DAISY. The motive for the murder is either sentimental factor, regarding money or for revenge. What is the truth?

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: The police proves that the victim is actually not LEE MAN FONG. HIN is neglectful of his job. The police finds out that KIT is in financial difficulty. He and his wife set up a plot to cheat the caution money. Unexpectedly, he indirectly puts his wife to death. YUNG finds out that the victim is actually, CHAN CHOI LING, also thirty-two years old. She was killed by KIT and his wife. Meanwhile, FONG’s dead body is found. There is KIT's finger—print on the murderous weapon. KIT then becomes one of the suspect. The police finds out that KIT is not the real murderer after thorough investigation. In fact, DAISY had followed KIT. She found that KIT's wife was still alive. She was very jealous as KIT had cheated her. She then killed KIT's wife.

She confesses that she is the murderer. The case is eventually cleared.YUNG's girlfriend KO GIT (reporter of the Fax Truth Magazine). GIT likes YUNG more after this incident.YEE and YE go to he Lobster Bay flying kite. One the way they hear a man shouting for help. They hurry to the spot and find that the man is pierced by an arrow. He is bleeding terribly. The man tells them that he was shot by the ‘Angel’ before he died.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The police finds out that the victim is SAM, a special reporter who is an expert in disclosing the famous people's privacy. He then extorts money from those people. The police believes that the motive for the murder is for revenge. The police sends YUNG and YEE to investigate the case. They find a bank pass book stating a recent deposit amount to hundred and fifty thousand dollars. They also find that the 'Angel' is actually a nightclub girl, ANGEL. YEE is ordered to look over her twenty-four hours a day. In order to get rid of the police, ANGEL disguises as a pregnant woman. She is crashed down by a car when she tries to escape away. She is seriously inured. She tells the police that she was extorted for hundred and fifty thousand dollars for concealing the fact that she had crashed her ex-boy friend to death. The police knows that she is not the murderer. They got some clue from SAM's watchman. They suspect YE.… ...

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: YEE discovers that YE had withdrawn hundred fifty thousand dollars. The date she withdrew the money was the same day SUM deposited the money. YEE also finds a photo with the image that YE is darting an arrow. The police suspects YE. They start a thorough investigation on YE.YE arranges to go to the Lobster Island with YEE. YUNG and CHIT follow them by car. YE arrives the destination earlier than YEE. She arranged everything in the female toilet before YEE arrives. They witness YE who is trying to shot YEE. They shot YE so as to stop her. YEE jumps forward to rescue the murderer. She then knows more about the case. He follows YE's elder sister to a children centre. He is shocked to find out that this centre named ‘Angel’.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: YUNG finds out that the handicapped children at 'Angel Children Centre’ were all victims of the prohibited medicine 'Aldalin'. Meanwhile, YE's statement stated that her elder sister had taken this medicine which made her given birth to a handicapped baby. This in turn destroyed her marriage. The victim, SUM, had extorted money from her. YE thus killed SUM for redemption. YE's elder sister has eventually told her current husband the truth. They give statement at court in the hope of mitigating YE's charge. The case has eventually come to an end. YEE and YUNG and CHIN's girlfriend go to the Lantan Island to visit the Buddhist Statue. YUNG has taken the wrong knapsack. Later, he receives a phone call from a mysterious woman who wants to get back her knapsack. YUNG goes to meet this woman according to her instruction. Unexpectedly, he finds that the owner of this knapsack had been died a year ago.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: YEE and YUNG check the old file. They find out that the victim named MEI. She committed suicide a year ago together with her boyfriend, HON, who is a foreigner. YEE and YUNG inspect the satchel. They discover a letter which was written by MEI to FUNG (who had died 5 years ago). It depicts how they were persecuted by Butterfly. YEE and YUNG even receive a call front MEI’s spirit. She implores them to clear the case for her. They find out that both FUNG and HON did have an affair with a rich lady, TING, who has married.FUNG is the member of the Butterfly Club. He had been fallen in love with TING. FUNG had fell down from a cliff and died five years ago when he tried to catch a butterfly. HON is TING’s subordinate. CHIT is asked to investigate TING. YEE and YUNG go to MEI's school for some hints. They find out that MEI and CHIT are classmates. CHIT's plot is unveiled.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: CHIT tells them that MEI was killed by TING as she has an affair with ON (TING’s husband). YEE and YUNG does not believe CHIT’s words. They further investigate. They apply for reading MEI and HON’s coroner’s report. They find out that MEI and HON had taken too much sleeping pills. Besides, MEI was strangled by a tie and HON hanged himself on the tree. The spot was a villa belonged to Hon's good friend. HON always went there with a mature lady. Moreover, a child states that MEI was a new face to him and she rarely went there. This indicates that MEI is not HON's real girlfriend. Moreover, LAI had also been to Japan five years ago. It is claimed that FUNG tried to catch a special butterfly and unfortunately fell down from the cliff. TING is the only witness. However, LAI finds out that the kind of special butterfly had already extinct as the kind of special bean which those butterflies depended on was in shortage.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: YEE and YUNG read TING’s testimony. They find out that the day they died was her wedding anniversary. ON is the only time witness for TING. He proves that he was with TING to celebrate their anniversary. KEE (TING’s secretary) Stated that HON had called TING a several times that day. He lost his temper and claimed that TING had cheated him. YUNG finds a picture painted a butterfly with the help from a villa keeper. HON had once wanted to give it to a friend but he kept it for himself at the end. YUNG discovers the alphabet‘ J4E’ from the picture. He even knows that HON likes to sleep on a hanging bed. The child from the village picks sonic tore off pieces of the hanging bed. They reckon that TING and HON were secret lovers. TING sets a plot to destroy the two so as to maintain her reputation.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: YEE and YUNG do not have enough time to appeal. CHIT does not give up. She meets ON when she is visiting MEI’s tomb. She follows him and finds that he had secluded in a villa at the suburban area. CHIT dresses herself up similar to MEI in order to win ON's favour. She soon becomes ON’s friend and wins his trust. She finds that TING killed the two was out of jealousy. She married ON for the sake of wealth. ON and TING do not love each other. Till ON meets MEI he finds real love. ON was made drunk by TING on that night. YUNG has no courage to disclose the truth. CHIT pretends to be MEI’s spirit and writes letter to TING. She claims that she will take revenge. She even sends TING the small piece of HON’s hanging bed.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: CHIT is happy to see TING so frightened. She even arranges to interview her. TING agrees to meet CHIT at the Butterfly Villa. Unexpectedly, TING threatens CHIT with a pistol. In fact, TING her sent a private detective to investigate CHIT. She sees through CHIT’s plot. She also knows that CHIT always contact her husband. TING is very angry. Fortunately, ON, YUNG and YEE follow CHIT. They arrive in time. TING flees away frightenedly. Consequently, she dies in a car crash. CHIT could eventually take revenge for her good friends. YUNG is assigned to arrest to arrest an escaped criminal. He eventually arrests this criminal in a villa at Sai Kung Simultaneously, he discloses HIN’s secret affair with woman. CHIT’s wedding plan thus calls off.

videos.overview: A nightclub girl, MEI's, dead body was found at her own apartment. The police finds an obscene video-cassette tape. Unexpectedly, the male protagonist is Inspector FUNG's husband, LAI. The coroner's report shows that MEI’s rib were chopped, her back was shot an her head was hit by something hard and causes a crush at her head bone. Moreover, she was being poisoned. LAI disappears. The murder weapon got LAI’s finger-print. However, there is also a left-hand finger-print belonged to another people. YUNG finds the mamasan for more information. He then knows that MEI always went out with a drug addict, TSUEN. They even set plot to trick the nightclub customers. Later, MEI was sacked. TSUEN was chopped to death by his debtors. MEI then becomes very rich.

LAI was so shocked that he hit MEI with a copper statue and left. LAI claims that he then wandered around in the street after this incident. Therefore, he does not have any time witness. LAI is then being detained. The police finds three more obscene video-cassette tapes at MEI’s safe-box at a bank. They arrest those three victims, FU, MING and Hei. They all got witness to prove their innocence.

The three defendants eventually could not controlled their temper and attacked the victim with a poisoned needle, a knife and a pistol.

He is so angry that he attacked the victim with a copper statue. He stole the diamond bracelet and left. KEUNG is being charged of murderer.

He always suspects TONG who is not his flesh and blood child. Thus, he is very cool to TONG. MAN’s old lover, CHOR, backs to Hong Kong from overseas. He wants to recover the old relation with MAN. It soon becomes the hot-gossiping issue of the press. MAN and TONG quarrel with each other. MAN and her mother, KUEN, set a plot to kidnap TONG. They aim to test CHIU and see how much does CHIU love TONG. Unexpectedly, TONG is really being kidnapped. The kidnapper asks for over thirty million ransom. Time is tight. CHIU has no other alternative.… ...

It is because FAI's wife and daughter was died of accident at CHIU’s site. However, he does not receive any reasonable compensation. CHIU does not show up to the police station to identify the criminal. YUNG then goes to CHIU’s home and discovers the kidnapping case. YUNG and YUEN hurry to the empty flat to find CHIU. They find that CHIU was dead and the ransom lost. The coroner's report shows that CHIU was chopped to death. FAI is the major suspect. The police finds out that FAI is actually not the real murderer. He even plans to have money reward for any information provided for clearing up the case.Soon there is some news form a citizen. This citizen states that he witness CHOR who let the spot secretly with bloodstain. The police checks CHOR’s record and find out the he is a retired singer. MAN is interrogated. She gives testimony stating that CHOR will only release TONG with the condition that she left Hong Kong . YUEN is the only person who knew the case. She goes to Cheung Chau to pick TONG up according to CHOR’s instruction. However, she waits for a long time and cannot meet them. The police checks YUEN’s background and finds that he is an illegitimate child. Thus, he only receives one-ten of the family property and wealth. YUEN could inherit all family property and wealth if CHIU died. The brand of the cigarette filter at the spot also matches with YUEN's used brand. Soon YUEN's girlfriend, NEI, reports to the police and asks for protection. She unveils the truth. She had helped YUEN to kidnap TONG. Later, she found that CHOR was dead.… ...

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: NEl also tells that TONG has already fainted at her home. The police hurries to the spot to save TONG. Simultaneously, CHIT suspects YUEN. She slips into his flat and check for NEI’s address at his telephone book. She then hurried to NEI’s flat. YUEN also suspects CHIT who has had checked NEI's address at his flat. Thus, he also hurries to NEI's flat with the aim to kill TONG so as to cover the truth. YUEN brings TONG away with him. The police eventually arrests YUEN after a fierce chase. However, he does not tell the police TONG’ location. The police discloses the nevus to the public. MAN implores YUEN to tell her TONG’s whereabouts. YUEN refuses. However, YUEN is filled with remorse. In order to satisfy his conscience, he tells them that TONG is hidden in a container. YUNG could eventually rescue TONG who is nearly died.

WAI admits that that night he escorted her home but after that he returned to his studio. As there is no one proving' WAI's statement, he cannot prove that he is innocent. WAI’s counsel KIT and four waiters claim that WEI was in the coffee shop of a hotel and he wore an orange jacket. As the jacket has been sent to a laundry, KIT's statement is not accepted. In fact WRI tries to hide the truth as his filthy relationship with the owner of the hotel may be disclosed. The fourth case occurs and ADA is the victim. Luckily ADA regains her consciousness.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: ADA reports that she was attacked by the sex maniac from behind and she fainted. YUNG gets an idea and they narrow down their scope of investigation to doctors and YUNG- finds that doctors have more chances to be close to their patients. After checking it is discovered that all the four victims were clients of St. Peter's Clinic. SUT, MING and CHAI are suspected as they' are doctors there. MAN is instructed to go to the clinic to bait the real murderer with “Envy”. She takes refuge in a unit being protected by the police. The killer arrives but is frightened by the alarm of the life which is out of order. YUNG sees the car of the villain and they focus on SUT and CHAI as they have the car of the similar style. It is found that SUT had bought a bottle of “Envy” near MAN’s unit and then he disappeared. It is rather certain that SUT is the sex maniac as the four victims’ records are found in his house.… ...

videos.overview: However medical checking shows that SUT had been poisoned to a comatose state before being killed in the traffic accident. Moreover there is no finger-print on the steering wheel. It is certain that it is a set up murder. YUNG and YI rush to save MAN but it is too late. MAN has been kidnapped by CHAI. Seeing that he has been surrounded, CHAI releases MAN and goes to the roof, trying to kill himself. CHAI committed the cases as he was shocked by his wife who had betrayed him. The situation worsened as he found that his son was not his flesh and blood. His anger explodes when he met the victims with “Envy”. His wife had a gift of “Envy” from her secret lover. He went insane and calmed himself by killing the victims. When he knew that he was suspected, he used tricks to frame SUT but in vain. He has to face trial by the law.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: In a used car lot, a corpse is found. It has been burnt seriously. The only hints about the identity are the feminine gender and the letters “TL” on her necklace. FUNG asks the public to supply useful information through the mass media. The next morning a teacher working in an evening institute. The identity of the corpse is clarified. She is LAI and has disappeared for three days. On the other hand, the press receives information from CHING who tells the press that LAI killed her daughter in a traffic accident one year ago. YUNG goes to ask CHING but cannot find her. He suspects that LAI was killed by CHING who wanted to avenge her daughter's death. More background of LAI is disclosed. Before working as a teacher in the evening institute, LAI worked as CHEUNG's secretary. She was dismissed by CHEUNG's wife who was discontented with the intimate relationship between CHEUNG and LAI.… ...

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: FUNG does not agree with YUNG. She refuses to continue the investigation as it is a waste of time and resources of the police. CHIT uses YUNG's idea as the main theme of her novel. She realizes that if YUNG is correct, LAI's situation is dangerous as she may be killed by CHEUNG who wants to keep his secret. Meanwhile the police find LAI and CHEUNG in a flat. CHEUNG is dead. LAI is sent to the hospital. When she regains her consciousness, she reports that CHEUNG attacked her so as to keep his secret. It happened as YUNG suggested. However it is found that CHEUNG was not killed by a knife. Instead he was poisoned. CHEUNG's wife declares that she killed CHEUNG with pesticide as she knew that CHEUNG was not loyal to her. The case is solved.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: YI and CHI go to Japan to enjoy their holiday. Before getting abroad, YI meets HO whom is believed to have died for five years. YI delays his trip to find what has happened. YI and HO lived in the same walled village. HO left her home as she was forced to marry a man that she did not love. She went overseas to study design. SAN was HO's boyfriend. The police questioned him and suspected that HO had been killed by SAN as some blood stints were found on his jacket. SAN admitted that he had been in HO's house. Though he was suspected, the police did not have strong evident to prove him guilty. SAN was set free. Later SAN killed himself and left a letter stating that he felt guilty. YI checks the file of HO's case. He is shocked to see that SAN cannot kill himself with the rope as he used his left him. YI suspects that it is a homicide.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: YI visits FUK, who is SAN's father. It is too late as he has died for two days. The way of handling the rope is the same as SAN’s. FUK has no reason to kill himself. There are a Double-T ticket and a map in his pocket. With the help of the map, the police find BILL's corpse. BILL is a wanted criminal who committed a bank robbery five years ago. He was killed but the money is not with him. As BILL and HO have the same blood type, thus five years ago, BILL was killed instead of HO. It is clear that the one who has taken the money is the killer. SAI, CHOI and KEUNG are suspected as they became rich in the past five years. MAN returns to FUK's house and a needle is found. She realizes that FUK was paralyzed and became unconscious before being killed. They check FUK corpse and MAN's idea is proven.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: KEUNG is the only one who knows Chinese medicine and the use of needles. YI is aware of the unnatural response of KEUNG's wife PING. He follows her and finds HO being locked up in a deserted warehouse. PING is going to deliver a baby. YUNG sends her to hospital and tries to contact KEUNG. He cannot find KEUNG as KEUNG has gone to Devil Hill with YI. YI and KEUNG are good brothers. YI tries to convince KEUNG to surrender himself to the police. He does not know that his life is endangered. SAI, CHOI and TSUI are KEUNG's colleagues. They try to kill YI. YUNG comes and fires his gun. TSUI is so afraid that her gun hurts SAI. She and KEUNG run away. KEUNG is arrested. He goes to the hospital and he finds that his wife is safe. He tells the police everything about the case. SAI dies as he has been injured seriously. TSUI kills herself as she feels guilty. CHOI is arrested.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: YUNG meets his former supervisor KAN. Now they are of the same rank. CHUN, who is the grandson of the King of Jewelry, is kidnapped. KAN is sent to YUNG's district to investigate the case. YI checks the CHIUs. The eldest son of the family has died and his wife controls the fortune of the family. The second son is discontented with his sister-in-law. However he is not a talented man. He only enjoys his life. As the second son is in financial difficulties as he indulges in gambling. The second son is suspected. The criminal calls the second son and asks him to tell the others the arrangement of giving money. The police suspect the second son. However the criminal does not come as stated. The criminal calls again and the phone is received by the branch manager. The second son may not be the criminal. Suddenly the criminal arrives in a car at high speed. He takes the money away. The police follows him.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: KAN's prediction is wrong and thus the criminal manages to escape. Luckily CHUN is saved. The police view the video tape over and over again and at last it is recognized that the criminal is TUNG who was a policeman. He was arrested by KAN and was dismissed as he had stolen the money robbed from a bank. YUNG follows TUNG's elder sister to the flat where TUNG stays. However he has left. TUNG's sister tells YUNG that she was given two hundred thousand dollars by TUNG. TUNG told her that he had won Mark Six. After checking it is proven that the money belongs to the CHIUs. YUNG and KAN want to arrest TUNG. KAN is so quick-tempered that he guns down TUNG.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Incidentally YUNG finds a boy's shoe in KAN's house and it is of the same pair of another one being found in TUNG's house. KAN knows that his secret is discovered and admits that he is involved in the case. TUNG kidnapped KAN's son to take vengeance on KAN. KAN kidnapped CHUN so as to get the money to save his son. A corpse is found in a construction site. WING checks it and finds that the man died six or seven years ago. He has six fingers and wounds are found on his bones. YUNG seeks help from HIN. With computer technology, HIN rebuilds the dead man's appearance so as to identify him.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: However HIN’s method cannot be employed as a piece of acceptable evident in the court. The model is lost on its way back to Hong Kong from the United Kingdom. YUNG takes the draft and asks the people living near the construction site. At last it is recognized by BING who owns a store. She recognizes him as LEUNG and he was LAN's boyfriend. It was said that he had gone to Singapore. KUEN is LAN's friend. LAN has a son and a daughter. LAN always quarrel with WING. She asks KUEN to keep an iron box for her as she is afraid that WING may dispose of it. The police visit LAN. LAN is shocked to learn that LEUNG is dead. WING is also shocked and he asks the police to leave.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: LAN uses town gas to kill herself. Though she is saved, she is in a deep comatose and has little chance to wake up. As LAN’s keys are lost, YUNG suspects that LAN was murdered instead of committing suicide. He also finds that WING tries to find something in LAN's house. KUEN gives the ox to the police. It contains a letter and a photograph stating that WING was all right in Singapore. However it is found that the letter was written by WING. The lost model is found in WING's house. The police also discover that WING makes frequent donations to St. Maria's Church. WING is questioned but no further information can be obtained. He is set free. The police keep an eye on WING and find that WING asks his girlfriend YAN to take money and flowers to the church. Suddenly WING reports to the police that he was the killer of LEUNG and LAN. He did so as he hated LEUNG who wanted-to take the role of his father.… ...

videos.overview: LAN regains her consciousness. She tells YUNG that WING did not hurt her. That day BING visited her and questioned her. BING was LEUNG's intimate girlfriend and she was angry as LAN had killed LEUNG. In chaos BING pushed LAN to the floor and LAN fainted. BING is questioned but she refuses to admit. FUNG and MIN have announced their engagement. LI falls down from a ladder in the studio and dies.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: It is realized that LI is not involved in WA's case. She needed money not because of being threatened by WA, instead she used the money to help her brother. As the screws had been loosened before she fell from the ladder, it is clear that she was murdered. YI thinks that it is only a joke instead of manipulated homicide. FUNG and. MIN have announced their engagement and the ceremony takes place in FUNG's house. However FUNG announces it is only a gag. He will not marry MIN. MIN feels being fooled. She is discontented as FUNG has another lover. She is on the brink of collapse but she still promises to act in the film. She tells the journalist that she wants to avenge her being humiliated. When they are acting, MIN shots FUNG with a real gun. FUNG dies and the others are shocked.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: MIN is arrested. In MIN's car, YUNG finds the forgery gun. Most likely she has left it in her car and she wants to destroy it. At the same time, an informant reports that the gun was sold by a drugs smuggler to a girl looking like MIN. MIN is accused of committing homicide. The police starts questioning FUNG's previous lovers. They are surprised to know that all the “lovers” are gags of the film making company. All the “lovers” state that FUNG is a good man.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: The case becomes more complex as the solicitor announces that FUNG wants to give one-sixth of his fortune to his manager SAU and one-half to his lover MIN. After consideration, the police figure out that LI died for MIN as MAN should be the one on the ladder. Thus the one being threatened may be FUNG. A camera is found in FUNG's house. The film is finished and the photographs are shocking. MIN goes to FUNG’s house where she sees SAU putting on dresses. In fact FUNG and SAU are lovers. Their abnormal love was found by WA who blackmailed them. SAU killed WA to keep the secret. Later FUNG fell in love with MIN. FUNG changed his mind where he knew that SAU had killed WA for him. However he did not want to continue the love. SAU hated MIN and wanted to set up a trap to frame MIN having killed FUNG. His plan was spoiled by the video tapes.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: When SAU is going to kill MIN, the police arrive. There is a gun fight. MAN protects YUNG with her body. SAU is killed. MAN is hurt seriously. Fortunately she recovers. However her legs are paralyzed. There is only fifty percent of recovery. YUNG looks after her as his life was saved by her. However CHIT is jealous. LUN's corpse is found on the stony beach of Tai Mong Tsai. For checking it is found that LUNG had taken sleeping pills before being killed by carbon monoxide. LUN is a keen gambler and this hobby always put him in financial difficulties. His wife is PO and KWAN is his secret lover. They have witness to prove that they were not with LUN when he was killed. LUN owns a saloon. PO works in a flower shop and KWAN is a taxi dancer. Before LUN was killed, the guard of the building saw a girl in red clothes came to drive LUN away. However he could not see the girl.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: LIK, who is the partner of LUN, is suspected as the killer for three reasons. Firstly, his father runs a garage and thus LIK is good at car mechanics. Secondly LIK and LUN had quarrels over financial matters. Thirdly LIK and KWAN has filthy relationship behind LUN. However LIK has witness to prove that he was not with LUN when LUN was killed. The police go to question PO's family but no useful information is found. When they are on the way back to the headquarters, they meet a truck driver. His truck's tires went flat at Sap Shi Heung when LUN was killed. He saw a girl in red clothes driving a white car and leaving in a hurry. Thus they return to the scene where they find a burnt cigarette with lip prints on it.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: However the case has not been solved. LUN was taken away by the girl in red at 8:00 p.m. and she was seen at Sap Shi Heung at 9:00 p.m. At 10:15 p.m. LIN was killed at Tai Mong Tsai. YI accompanies PO and her grandmother to home from hospital. YI finds an old photograph taken when PO was a student. YI suspects PO's classmates and thus he takes the photograph away. As the school has been pulled down, YI seeks help from computer experts. From the photographs, the recent appearance of the three students are projected. One of them is KWAN. As PO and KWEN were classmates, YI finds that KWAN's cigarette is the same as the one left at Sap Shi Heung. He also discovers that KWAN had stolen her neighbour's car which is white in color when LUN was killed. At last the police conclude that LUN was killed by KWAN and PO. KWAN and PO killed LUN as both were sent to hospital. When they met, they realized that both of them had been deceived by LUN.… ...

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: CHUNG, who is a merchant, is found killed in the suite of a hotel. He was strangled to death when he was in a comatose after being hit. He money has been taken away. CHUNG and his cousin LAM won six hundred thousand dollars from the horse race. He took the money to a ballroom alone as LAM had to go home for private business. There CHUNG wanted to hire JUDY to play SM with him but he was refused. BETTY states that JUDY did not go with CHUN. BETTY’s statement is further supported by her customer FAY. Thus JUDY is not regarded as the suspect of the case. CHIT visits a doctor from whom she learns a case of a poor baby girl. The baby girl is waiting for financial support to go overseas to receive proper treatment. CHIT reports her case and it draws public attention. An anonymous old man donates six hundred thousand dollars to support the baby girl.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: The surgery is successful and the baby girl regains her healthy. CHIT has done much for her. CHIT is surprised to find that the baby girl's mother TUNG TUNG is BETTY. BETTY pays little attention to her baby. CHIT is discontented and always looks after the baby for BETTY. LIN is the owner of the hotel where CHUNG was killed. He is found dead in his house in Sheraton. He died after drinking poisonous milk. He has a complex family. CHU is the daughter given birth by his ex-wife. KWONG is his son-in-law and his nephew KAI is his wife WA's good friend. WA is much younger than LIN. CHU, KWONG, KAI and WA have different people to prove that they were not in the house when LIN was killed. The newspaper hawker reported that there was a mysterious lady wandering outside the house when LIN was killed. When the murder was committed, the rear door had not been locked. Every day SHEUNG takes the milk there.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Another witness tells the police that CHU's car was outside the house when LIN was killed. CHU changes her statement. She claims that. before going to the airport with KWONG, she visited her father and seek financial support from him for her husband. However the time she left was close to the time of LIN's death. CHU accuses WA and KAI as the killers as there is filthy relationship between them. WA accuses CHU as CHU is unable to pay her debts. FAY is also suspected as they had quarrels. FAY works as a cook in LIN's hotel. He was introduced to the job by KAI. FAY's working attitude is poor. KAI and RAY have long not met each other. On the day when landslide affected Tuen Mun, they came across each other in a restaurant in Yuen Long, they did not greet each other. As the landslide and the murder occurred on the same day, the police find that FAY's statement supporting BETTY becomes invalid.… ...

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Before she died, BETTY called CHIT. BETTY told CHIT that she had the idea to kill the baby so as to get compensation from the insurance company. Luckily the baby is all right. CHIT also heard the music of a wind bell. CHIT recognizes that the music is the last piece in the department store. The police go to the department store and the shopkeeper recognizes BETTY and reports that she and a man came and bought the piece. CHIT finds the man but the shopkeeper firmly states that he is not the one. The man warns CHIT to mind her own business. It is found that BETTY's skin tissues was left in CHUNG's fingernails. The newspaper hawker also identifies her as the mysterious girl outside LIN's house. Thus it is clear that BETTY killed CHUNG for money. But why did she kill LIN? Moreover it is believed that BETTY did not kill herself. She was killed by the black hand who wanted to keep the secret. The man threatened CHIT is FAY.… ...

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: CHIT finds out who the black hand is, endangering herself. However the police do not have strong evident to accuse him. The police attempt to accuse him of three charges. Though KAI tells everything he knows, his words are not trusted as he suffers from cancer. CHIT's colleague SEE is going to marry MAN. SEE tells CHIT that she has no faith in marriage as four years ago, her sister and brother-in-law were killed by her brother-in-law's secret lover. However the court stated that it was only an accident and the killer was set free. Incidentally SEE comes across the killer RACHEL in the street. She claims that she is CARMAN but SEE insists on accusing her being RACHEL the killer. CARMAN is confused. CHIT finds that both CARMAN and RACHEL have the same surname NAM.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: SEE calls CHIT and tells her that she has strong prove to support her idea. Then she does not turn up. Later her corpse is found in her house. She was suffocated by a cushion and it seems that the killer wanted to find something before he left. MAN is the suspect but his brother WING can prove that he is innocent. MAN is questioned again as he has bought an insurance policy for SEE. They have joint account and a flat. On the day when SEE was killed, he withdrew five hundred thousand dollars from the account. MAN claims that he has another witness but the witness has migrated to the USA. He cannot prove that he is not the killer. Later MAN falls down from the roof of a building and dies. It is regarded as a suicidal case as MAN feels guilty. However it is wrong as MICHAEL returns and proves that MAN did not kill SEE.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: CARMAN is on the brink of collapse and she is annoyed with a nightmare relating to the murder four years-ago. She is depressed to see CHIT and YUNG being so intimate. MAGGIE returns from the United Kingdom and brings along with her some documents to prove that CARMAN did go there to study four years ago. Before MAN died, he claimed that MAGGIE could prove his words. However MAGGIE is killed and her parcel cannot be found. From the computer of the police force, CARMAN finds that she went to the United Kingdom to further her study four years ago. She had never been to the hospital like what her brother stated. In fact the hospital does not have her record. It is certain that CARMAN has lost her memory. CARMAN gradually regains her memory about the fire four years ago. CARMAN quits her job and agrees to leave with her brother.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: However it is a trick. After her brother has gone, CARMAN starts her plan of killing YUNG and CHIT. She wants to kill them with fire and the same tragedy occurs. Luckily it is stopped by YI and CHI. CARMAN is arrested and she admits all the charges. WING returns and surrenders himself to the police. He tells another story. It becomes confusing as it is hard to know who has told the truth. At last CARMAN is released. However she cannot confront her past and present. She chooses to leave Hong Kong alone. YUNG's colleagues organize a camping so as to bridge YUNG and CHIT but some unexpected incidents occur...

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: TO and his wife LAM have been lurked and attacked by a mysterious man three times. They are frightened and they inform the police. When it is the second time for TO to go to the police station, LAM is killed in their house. Some background information of the couple has been collected. LAM is the foster daughter of a billionaire. After the rich man's death, LAM and the rich man's son CHI had an argument in the right to inherit the fortune. The court gave LAM the right and CHI hated LAM. CHI tries to hide where he was when LAM was killed but his lie is spoiled by the employee IVY. At last he has to admit that he was with a male prostitute when the crime was committed. It proves that he is innocent and the killer is someone else.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: CHI attends LAM's funeral and there she recognizes that IVY is YUNG's ex-girlfriend. She also finds TO to be someone that she should know. Later CHI is killed in a traffic accident. The police discover that TO is not as loyal to his wife as one expects. Thus TO is believed to be the killer of LAM. YUNG leads his men to TO's office to arrest him. They cannot catch him because he dies after drinking a cup of poisonous coffee. Later it is found that IVY is TO's secret lover and her car is of the same model of colour of the one that killed CHI.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: As the police has no other evident to accuse IVY, FUNG detentes her for forty-eight hours so as to collect more information. when YUNG sees YAN wearing the ring given by TO, he suspects her as the real secret lover of TO. His idea is consolidated when he sees YAN expressing her hatred by tearing LAM's clothes. Moreover YAN knows driving and she has a car similar to that of IVY. When they get the information of where the car is, YUNG and YI go to arrest the killer. They are late and the car has been driven away. However they do not give up. They follow it and at last pushes it into a dead-ended alley. There they check who the driver is.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: YUNG and CHIT determine their date of marriage. In order to be a good wife, CHIT attends a cooking course. In the education centre, she meets a mysterious lady who intends to attend all courses. CHIT finds a vague image of the lady in her mind. She remembers that the lady is called TUEN MUK CHI. There was a lady with the same name who committed suicide six months ago. YUNG checks the file again and learns that the victim had left a letter to CHRIS before she killed herself. According to the record, CHI lived in CHING’s house. CHING is attacked and her house has been searched. CHIT suspects that CHRIS is NAM who works as a tutor in the education centre. However NAM is killed with a knife in the show room.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: The killer leaves no clue in the show room. After investigation, it is found that CHI is the daughter of WANG who runs big rubber business in Malaysia. As WANG did not accept CHI's boyfriend, CHI eloped with her boyfriend to Hong Kong. Some information of CHING and her photograph are found in NAM's house. It is because NAM has hired a private detective to check her. An employee of the education centre reports that before NAM was killed, he had had secret discussion with another tutor YUEN. Later YUEN is found killed by poison. Incidentally YUNG gets a video tape from a peeping Tom. From it the secret relationship between CHI, YUEN and NAM is exposed. They suspect that the killer is one of those in the education centre.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: The real identity of SUN, who works as the school janitor in the education centre, is confirmed. He admits that he is the one who killed YUEN and NAM to avenge CHI's death. All are under his control and the plan is made up by him. It seems that the case has been solved but YUNG suspects that it is not the end as the mysterious man who attacked CHING is still unknown. Later YUNG finds that the one who attacked CHING is SUM, another tutor. However he is shot to die. As SUN has been arrested, there is another killer. YUNG suspects that the killer is CHING's boyfriend CHRIS as he knows much about the education centre. However who is CHRIS?

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: At last CHRIS is found. It costs so much time to find CHRIS as everyone has adopted the wrong approach to the case. CHIT gives the invitation card to her former classmate SHIRLEY. She learns that SHIRLEY has an argument with her boyfriend SHUN. As SHUN has got married, SHIRLEY urges him to make a decision in their future or she will kill him and herself. Later SHIRLEY is found having fallen down from the roof of a building and she dies. The police believe that she kills herself as she is too confused in her love affairs. In the wedding ceremony of YUNG and CHIT, CHIT is knocked down and faints. She is in a comatose.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: CHIT is sent to the casualty. Senior Doctor YIN suspects that CHIT's nerve is suppressed by some abnormal cells of her brain. However treatment is difficult and dangerous. The chance to cure her with operation is low but if there is no further action, she will remain in the comatose forever. Meanwhile CHING leads another doctor BENNY to see CHIT. BENNY is an expert on brain and he discovers that the X-ray film with bad brain cells do not belong to CHIT. CHIT is still unconscious as she is under an anesthetic by an injection. Later YIN resigns and is found dead mysteriously. The police cannot find SHUN. NGAN's wife informs the police that NGAN and SHUN had been blackmailed for one million dollars before NGAN was killed. YUNG suspects that they were threatened by CHOI, who is the husband of their former patient. He did so to avenge his wife's death.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: SHUN's corpse is found and a cheque of one million dollars is found in his pocket. CHOI is YUNG's former classmate. KIN tells YUNG his worry. Twenty years ago, KIN used a wire to kill CHOI's bird. As YIN and SHUN were strangled to death by a wire, KIN worries that he will be the next target. CHIT wakes up and she loses her memory. No matter how hard YUNG, tries, he is unable to make her remember him. Meanwhile YUNG discovers that YIN and SHUN were threatened by TAT instead of CHOI. TAT is the husband of another patient of YIN and SHUN. Moreover it is certain that CHOI is innocent as his dead body is found floating in the sea.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: The case becomes more complex as of KIN and his wife YIN are found unconscious in KIN's car. As YIN’ has intestine cancer, poison cannot be diluted and at last she dies. KIN is cured and he discloses his plan to avenge and it involves a scandal relating to doctors...

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: After losing part of her memory, KO CHIT left CHEUNG TAI YUNG and started her new life alone in Canada. YUNG goes to find CHIT but in vain as she has started off to Beijing to organize an interview.  CHIT stays in Hong Kong and visits the psychologist who gave her treatment in the past. As he has retired, CHIT seeks treatment from HO CHI WANG.  YUNG secretly follows CHIT to Beijing. On the plane, a man named LAW TO FUNG claims that he is CHIT's friend. CHIT thinks that he is her former friend but she cannot recall him as she has lost part of her memory.  LI CHUNG YI arrives and informs YUNG that SHEK SIU WAI is blackmailed. YUNG goes to the police station with them.  CHIT has made an appointment to interview Professor CHEUNG. The appointment has to be postponed as Professor CHEUNG does not have time. The gangster blackmailing WAI does not turn up. However YUNG and KIU CHUN are aware that a lady is connected to the case.… ...

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: YUNG brings CHIT to the police to report the theft. However CHIT is frightened. In the third transaction, NAM CHING is arrested. She states that she works with WONG HO SANG in WAI's case. However they cannot find DSANG as SANG is dead.  CHUN finds the letter left by LING SIN WA and suspects that she is involved in SANG's death.  YUNG meets FUK CHIU HUNG, who is CHUN's mother. As CHUN indulges in his work and neglects his wife KEUNG YEUNG, HUNG is discontented.  CHIT suggests to break up with YUNG immediately when they arrive at Hong Kong. Her sister KO MAN suggests her to think over it carefully but is in vain. YUNG does not understand what has happened. He chases after CHIT and by mistake he hurts her leg. In the hospital MAN states that the X-ray film is not CHIT's as CHIT was hurt and screws should be found in her leg bones. Later MAN is knocked down by a car and is on the brink of death. It is a set up instead of an accident.… ...

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: YUNG questions CHIT but he is lurked. He faints and luckily he is saved by YI. When he regains his consciousness, he rushes back to Beijing where he finds the real CHIT is hospital.  CHIT can only recalls that she hurt SANG when he wanted to rape her. She can remember nothing fatter then.  The police accuse CHIT having killed SANG and do not allow YUNG to visit her. As YUNG can do nothing to help her, he is angry. Later YUNG seeks help from YU who is a green-handed lawyer.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: YUNG asks YU to send a letter to CHIT. CHUN is impressed by YUNG's love of CHIT and he goes home to stay with his wife.  CHIT faints and is sent to hospital. CHUN allows YUNG to visit her. They are happy to see each other. YUNG asks CHIT details of the case and finds many suspicious points.  In Hong Kong the fake CHIT, who in fact is LING SIN WA, wants to run away with WANG. However they are chased after by YI. They run away separately and WA is arrested by the Chinese police,  YI is sent to Beijing to investigate WA's case. WA claims that she did not kill anyone. She only impersonated CHIT so as to go to Hong Kong. YUNG worries as CHIT's situation is dangerous.  YUNG, YI and CHUN go to the site again. They find WA's hand print on a child's clothes. WA is surprised.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: As there is evidence, WA admits that the murder was done by her. CHIT and YUNG are excited. On the other hand, WANG returns and declares that all were killed by him. WA knows nothing about the case.  YEUNG is pregnant and HUNG is happy.  Both WA and WANG are condemned capital punishment while CHIT is released as she hurt SANG to protect herself. YUNG and CHIT return to Hong Kong after the trial.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: CHIT wants to move to Canada with MAN but at the last moment she decides to stay with YUNG. YUNG is excited.  YUNG and CHIT move to a flat near to YI's house. YI is discontented with LI SI LUNG who records his illegal parking every day. YUNG joins YI's team together to CHAK WING TIN who has a strange character.  CHU SAU KWAN is CHIT's aunt. She lives in CHIT's house. YI’s aunt also visits YI. YI accompanies his aunt to Guangzhou to receive treatment. On the return journey, LUI CHIN MEI sees a man being pushes down hill. The victim is her father LUI SAI HO.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: MEI is grievous and the case is complicated. YI looks after MEI and MEI thanks him. They mutually impress each other.  KWAN does not like CHIT learning cooking from YU PIK LING. LUNG is transferred to YUNG's team and YUNG instructs her to be YI's partner. LUNG knows that she is in trouble.  TIN follows the clue that one million dollars has been taken away from HO's account. YI pays MEI a visit and he finds a telephone number in HO's room. After checking he knows that KWOK SHU SUN had borrowed HO's money and they had had a quarrel in a bar before HO was killed.  MEI invites YI to stay with her in Lamma Island. They are drunken and fall asleep together. The next morning, SUN's corpse in found on the beach.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: A witness states that SUN jumped into the sea and killed himself. YI suspects that he killed himself as he felt guilty. However TIN does not accept YI's conclusion. YUNG and his colleagues check SUN's house and from SUN's MTR tickets and appointments, he could not be with HO when HO was killed. YUNG appreciates TIN's talent.  As YI and TIN have different ideas on the case, they argue. At the same time, YI is attracted by MEI's charm.  YUNG finds the relationship between HO, SUN and MEI's mother. MEI's mother was pregnant when she married HO. On the other hand an old worker reports that after MEI's mother death, HO raped MEI when he thought MEI was her mother. YI is confused and keeps an eye on MEI's behavior and character.  YI's aunt is hypnotized and recalls that she did not witness HO's pushed down hill. She thought she saw the case as instructed by MEI. It is clear that MEI is involved in the case.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: YI recalls that he found some salty smell on MEI's hair when they were on Larnma Island. POON CHI TO, a psychiatrist, warns that MEI is a dangerous person on the brink of explosion. YI flatters MEI but at the same time allows her to see him dating LUNG. MEI is confused and insane.  MEI invites YI to visit HO's tomb together. YUNG and the others get ready to take action. YUNG asks LUNG to go home as her mother has fainted.  Later YI finds that LUNG's mother did not have any problem. He realizes LUNG's dangerous situation and rushes to save her. MEI wants to push LUNG down the cliff with her car. YI arrives just in time to save LUNG and arrest MEI.  MEI admits what she has done and kills herself in the police station.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: CHIT visits TO. TO is impressed by her and asks her to take a part-?time job.  CHIT becomes a part-time journalist and she interviews the winners of a cooking competition. KWAN is unhappy as LING is also a participant.  KWAN makes friend with HUNG and is attracted by him. In the press conference KWAN Is nagged by LING. Thus she drives a car towards LING to frighten LING. LING is nearly knocked down and all are taken to the police station.  TIN frightens LING to give up accusing KWAN but KWAN does not know TIN's kind act. In fact TIN was KWAN's fiance. When KWAN realizes that HUNG is their new supervisor, she is happy.  As KWAN's hand is hurt, she cannot take part in the competition. LING wins the competition.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: TIN goes to the inn which they always visited in the past on the outlying island. There he finds KWAN. However it is too late and there is no ferry service. Thus they spend a night on the beach and wait for the dawn. The next morning, TIN brings KWAN to the police station.  TIN and LUNG go to Mei King Bay to find witness for KWAN. There they find an artist who drew a portrait of KWAN when she had fallen asleep. His statement proves that KWAN is innocent.  CHIT and KWAN visit MUI. They find a rose paper weight. CHIT also gets information that PONG, who was a merchant, was found dead in Singapore after eating LING's food. YUNG suspects LING.  YUNG discovers the secret love between PONG and MUI. CHIT recalls the paper weight and also the time difference of their last phone call.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: CHIT checks MUI's telephone in her company and discovers her trick on her phone. CBIT is aware that MUI is involved in the case. She also remembers the wooden box of MUI. CHIT and KWAN go to Mei King Bay again. YUNG and his colleagues also arrive at MUI's house.  MUI is arrested and accused of being LING's murderer.  LUNG's mother is dying. She tells LUNG that her father is not her genetic father. LUNG is reminded to find her real father. YI provides with LUNG accommodation.  YUNG's stepbrother comes from the USA. CHIT and KWAN do not like his style.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: CHIU's corpse is found along a river. On seeing the decaying corpse, LUNG feels sick.  KWAN misinterprets HUNG's intention, thinking that he invites her to see an opera together. In fact she is only a baby-sitter. LUNG tells CHIT her life-saver when she was a child. In fact her life-saver is YI but both do not know.  YUNG and CHIT come across TUNG when they are dating. TUNG wants to kill herself but is saved by them.  CHIT introduces FAY to be a part-time photographer. FAY is excited. TUNG is YUNG's old friend. She tells CHIT her unpleasant experience. She married a musician LIM. LIM was unemployed, thus she worked hard to earn their livings. She was shocked and wanted to commit suicide as she found the filthy relationship between LIM and her sister LAM. Later LAM is found dead.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: LAM is dead and her corpse is terrible. Her neighbor SA reports that before LAM died, there was loud music. YI is careless and breaks SA's Mickey mouse glass.  YUNG and YI check the four involved persons. They know that one of them was sent to hospital in Macau. They suspect CHIU as the killer.  An old lady comes and recognizes that the corpse is CHIU. YUNG feels strange as TUNG cannot identify the corpse correctly. In the television program, TUNG advises LIM to return. In fact she uses the name of the song to warn LIM not to show up. YUNG cannot realize her trick immediately.  TUNG refuses to eat KWAN's cake as she is allergic to eggs. LUNG also gets the medical report from the hospital. YUNG accuses TUNG of telling lies.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: YUNG discloses TUNG's trick of misidentifying the corpse. TUNG tells the truth.  In fact TUNG and CHIU went to Macau first. Then they asked LIM and LAM to discuss the matter. However they could not compromise.  YI takes care of LUNG and tells her that he saved a girl when he was young. LUNG realizes that YI is her life-saver but she does not have the courage to tell him.  YUNG follows TUNG and finally finds LIM. YUNG arrests LIM. LIM tells YUNG the whole story. CHID loved LAM and even stole his company's money for her. However LAM loved LIM. Therefore CHID planned to kill LIM after killing LAM. However CHIU was killed by LIM by mistake. After telling YUNG everything, LIM rushes into towards a car and is knocked down. He dies in the street.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: FAY and HAY are old friends. HAY's husband owns a magazine. CHIT is aware of the friendship between FAY and HAY. One day FAY and HAY go out with HAY's son BOR. BOR is knocked down by a car and dies. HAY blames herself and feels guilty.  SA asks YI to investigate her mother's death. Her mother YING died eighteen years ago. As SA finds a letter left by YING, she believes that YING did not kill herself.  TIN was responsible for YING's case, so YI asks him. Later YI and LUNG go to TIN's home and from his neighbor, YI learns that TAI B visited TIN frequently and on the day of YING's death, he was also there.
